name: Diltiazem
mechanism: Non-dihydropyridine CCB - blocks L-type calcium channels in heart and vessels
dosing: Hypertension: 60mg BD or 120mg XL daily. Angina: 60mg TDS or 120-300mg XL daily
contraindications: Heart block, sick sinus syndrome, severe bradycardia, severe heart failure
interactions: Beta-blockers (↑ bradycardia), digoxin (↑ levels), simvastatin (↑ levels)
monitoring: Heart rate, blood pressure, signs of heart failure, liver function
pregnancy: Avoid unless essential - limited safety data
sideEffects: Bradycardia, heart block, ankle oedema, constipation, gingival hyperplasia
clinicalPearls: Rate-limiting CCB. Good for AF rate control. Avoid with beta-blockers
